businesses.business: Calibration services and test instrument distribution

offering_description.value: Transcat calibrates, repairs and manages measurement instruments for regulated manufacturers, industrial facilities and government customers. It performs calibration in its own laboratories and at customer sites, and sells and rents test instruments made by other companies.

primary_products.value: Electrical test meters; pressure gauges and calibrators; temperature measurement instruments; process calibrators; test instrument accessories

primary_services.value: Instrument calibration; instrument repair; test equipment rental; equipment validation and qualification; instrument asset management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, aerospace contractors, industrial plants and utilities; B2G: Government laboratories and defense agencies

end_markets.value: Life sciences; aerospace and defense; industrial manufacturing; energy and utilities; electronics

revenue_model.value: service fees: Instrument calibration, repair and asset management; product sales: Test and measurement instruments and accessories; rental or leasing: Short-term and longer-term use of test equipment; project or contract: Equipment qualification, validation and ongoing calibration programs
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; rental or leasing; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Calibrates and repairs customer instruments for manufacturers, utilities and government laboratories; distributor: Sources instruments from equipment manufacturers and sells them to laboratories, industrial facilities and field technicians

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and Ireland

specialization.value: related lines: Instrument calibration, repair, validation, asset management, distribution and rental

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Account teams that arrange on-site calibration, equipment purchases and rentals; own locations: Calibration laboratories that receive customer instruments; online: E-commerce catalog for test instruments and accessories

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory accreditation and calibration documentation for customers subject to FDA manufacturing rules

notes: The full current geographic footprint is uncertain.
